responsibility: Declares the core interprocedural propagation abstractions used across GCC IPA passes. It defines jump-function kinds and payloads, parameter/edge/node summary types, IPA-CP transformation summary interfaces, public helpers for creating and querying summaries, target discovery for indirect calls, aggregate/jump-function utilities, transformation entry points, and debugging/streaming APIs. It is the principal header for the shared IPA propagation framework implemented mainly in ipa-prop.cc.
same_name_distinction: Provides the shared type and API definitions for the propagation system—jump-function enums/records, summary classes, extern summary objects, and helper declarations—while the operational analysis and transformation code lives in ipa-prop.cc.
